feeds.title: A Bird Hunter's Thoughts
feeds.description: This BLOG is a way for Randy Schultz to document his fun with bird dogs and bird hunting. He can also look at products and test them on the road, under actual hunting conditions. He enjoys doing that and have found some real gems in equipment and techniques.

feeds.description: Get the latest bird hunting articles, videos, podcasts, and bird dogs, from Project Upland Magazine including pheasant, quail, grouse, chukar, and more. Dedicated to those that love wild birds, public lands, shotguns, and hunting dogs, Project Upland Magazine delivers high-quality storytelling from all over our community that is a realistic reflection of the upland-obsessed.

feeds.title: Find Bird Hunting Spots
feeds.description: I am Scott Linden. When I'm not hunting on Wingshooting USA TV, I'm hunting for fun. My goal here, as well as on my podcast, in social media, books and magazine articles, is to help you find places to hunt upland birds. Finding bird hunting spots gets harder by the year, but there are plenty of great destinations if you know where and how to look! I hope you'll start here. Good luck!
